minimalChanges: Prefix monotonicity is keyed by verified runId/scopeId/controllerPID/exactCreationMicros, after actual prefix SHA replay and open-scope/controller binding. Cross-scope outer-start order is not incorrectly used as journal-prefix acquisition order.
Every scope retains original ordered calls and actual prefix bytes/SHA. Same-scope prefix rollback is refused even when both individual prefixes are real and independently valid.
Same-scope outer observation calls must not overlap: preceding actual observationCompletedMonotonic<=next actual monotonicSeconds. Different scopes may legitimately overlap.
No global clock, maximum3second coverage threshold, fixed phase, original stream order, resource limit, or historical predicate changed.

Native raw parent/PID-reuse checks follow this audit scope included managed identities. After all discovery raw ancestry chains are verified, discovered parent checks use only responsible_discovered; global scope=None retains the full owned family.
Fake ancestry cannot reduce responsibility because original native chain/scope/writer proof is completed before local filtering.
coherentControls: Earlier outer-start A legitimately has later actual graph capture and larger journal prefix than later-start B from another scope; both raw-prefix/state projections valid, union accepted.
Same-scope later row rolls back only a sibling scope-open suffix while preserving its actual own scope/live task leases; rejects at same-scope prefix gate.
Original native/projection body relabelled with a fresh sampleId and overlapping same-scope actual outer envelope rejects before it can masquerade as an additional observation.

An original parent-owned sibling changing parent outside a block is irrelevant to that local block but remains adverse to the enclosing root audit; same original raw/context is used for both assertions.
